repair_prompt.text: The current public page retains the same product facts but its extraction selectors no longer match. Restore exactly title, price, and availability from the current page while preserving the existing output schema. Return title as text, price as USD money with numeric value 599, and availability as Available. Do not approve, activate, commit, or change unrelated fields.

provider_identifier_policy: Extract only returned response_id, collection_id, operation_id, provider_operation_id, job_id, request_id, run_id, and id values. Record PROVIDER_ID=ABSENT when none exists; never substitute AEGIS IDs.
stop_conditions: Do not approve or rerun even if awaiting_approval and complete candidate are returned.
Do not retry failures, timeouts, absent candidates, or incomplete candidates.
